title: Warm Porridge

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: On a snowy morning there's nothing better than warm porridge! I'm making a big pot to take out to the farm.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Would you please weigh the oats? The beam hangs level when it's just right.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Add scoops of oats until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! Into the pot they go.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Mmm. Oats, milk and a little honey. That will warm everyone right down to their toes!

journal_line: I weighed oats for warm winter porridge with Mr. Tobias.
